trigger: Absolute relative difference between the selected N24 pilot nominal rate and (N-1)/arrival_span exceeds 0.15.
correction: Use the nearest 0.25 requests/s to the actual pilot arrival rate as the new nominal N128 confirmation point. Keep both policies, prompts, caps, graph settings, credits, generation seeds and arrival seeds identical within each pair.
namespace: New rate_matched_v2 namespaces. Preserve the initial plan and all initial prepared configs. Never edit an executed config or alter frozen SLO thresholds.
scope: Finite Poisson pilots can realize 25% more arrivals per second than their nominal rate. The correction tests the observed physical loading condition in a larger cohort. It is not a claim that nominal and realized QPS are equal, or that the rate is sustainable.
